detail.overview: Unveiling a visual feast, the Intex Google TV LED-SGUV5001 stuns with a massive 50-inch 4K Ultra HD display featuring HDR10 technology for exceptional detail. Witness over 1.07 billion colors come alive on the screen, creating an unparalleled viewing experience. Immerse yourself in cinematic sound with 20W Dolby Digital audio, for an entertainment experience that truly comes alive.
